_comment: Which Kenney City Kit (Roads) models (CC0) go into assets/street/street-props.glb, and how. file = model name in 'Models/GLB format'. height = target height in metres (the model is scaled evenly to it). rotY = degrees, turns the model so its arm / front points to +z (the game's 'forward'). glow = triangles whose baked (linear) colour has every channel above minLinear (0-1, the kit paints bulbs pure white) become a second mesh '<name>.glow' that lights up at night. grey = recolour the model in this colour, keeping its light and dark parts (tintRef = the kit brightness that becomes exactly this colour). Glow parts keep their colour.
